global_caption: The video contains two shots and is a multi-shot demonstration video in the science experiment and gaming genre. The visual theme is a cyberpunk Eastern mythological fairyland illuminated by warm orange neon. Floating palaces, jade platforms, and mecha components form a strange yet solemn experimental environment. The entire scene uses a warm color palette for visual unity, with lighting dominated by volumetric neon glow and metallic edge highlights. The global
shot1: Shot 1 opens with a fade-in, using a wide-angle upward composition. The foreground features swirling golden clouds and translucent energy mist, the midground shows a suspended jade platform, and the background displays layered palace silhouettes and glowing runes. Warm orange neon glows from the platform edges and eaves, highlighting the lion's metallic mane with edge light, while its body reflects gently flowing rune-like highlights. It walks steadily to the platform edge, and its claws strike the surface with a clear, heavy metallic thud. The surrounding air trails concentric rings of orange-gold afterimages and fine particles. The camera slowly pushes in from the upward angle with slight tilt tracking, guiding the orb swiftly downward from the top of the frame.
shot2: Shot 2 follows with a hard cut, transitioning to the floating track area below. The background remains the same warm orange cloud sea and suspended palace structure, ensuring spatial continuity. Lighting continues the previous neon volume and contour highlights, with stronger flickering reflections added only during impact to emphasize metallic texture and experimental key moments. The bright orb enters from the top of the frame and collides with the stationary metal ball, producing a brief, controlled orange-white impact flare. Before contact, the metal ball remains completely still; during contact, its surface exhibits high-frequency micro-vibrations and shimmering highlights; after contact, it clearly shows “一停一动”: the orb visibly decelerates and stops, while the cart is propelled forward along the track, its wheels scraping against the rails with a more intense metallic screech. At the same time, a holographic data interface beside the track flashes rapidly, displaying “动量守恒” in semi-transparent orange-gold text in the upper right corner, with numerical bars and vector arrows updating synchronously. The mecha-maned lion leans into the frame from the upper platform to observe the result, its mane tips vibrating slightly due to the downward airflow. The camera first slightly pulls back to stabilize in the eye-level close-up, then performs a short lateral pan along the track to follow the cart’s motion, finally stopping on the still-glowing holographic data and the moving apparatus, fully encapsulating the experimental outcome, object state changes, and mytho-cyber environment within a single frame.
